title: Custom Avatars Auto Grading not working
content:
If you are using custom avatars and have made a fit suit but you are getting "It only works for a simulated garment" message make sure GPU sim is turned off.

I haven't seen this mentioned before in regard to resolving the issue so I'm leaving it here.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. 🙂 Auto Grading has been renamed to Auto Fit. The tool should work in both CPU and GPU. on both CLO and Custom avatarsIf you are having issue with this we would recommend reaching out through the Contact Us page and including a file with a garment and registered custom avatar for our team to look closer at 🙂
content_description: This page provides a helpful tip to resolve the "It only works for a simulated garment" error when using custom avatars with fit suits by ensuring GPU simulation is turned off.

title: How can I fix the pattern in the air?
content:
![72a62ed4b15c43d69a8b8333727756e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c0a502024c594200ac0002f3d6e7348e/images/72a62ed4b15c43d69a8b8333727756e0%EC%8A%A4%ED%81%AC%EB%A6%B0%EC%83%B7%202025-06-16%20201849.png)

I’m studying CLO through YouTube. In the 2D window on the right, I saw that there are red dots above the rectangular pattern. It seems like those red dots are used to fix the pattern in the air. I'm curious—how can I add those red dots?  
  
The YouTube link is [초급04강 네크라인셔링블라우스 (0) 심지접착 & 본딩 (CLO7.1) / CLO Basic 04 Neckline Shirring Blouse (0) Bonding - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0OXSLTDGsMc&t=14s)

![4027c362197747288e628dcfe37b876f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c0a502024c594200ac0002f3d6e7348e/images/4027c362197747288e628dcfe37b876fimage.png)

Even after running the simulation, the pattern stays floating in the air. It's so fascinating!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi. This is called Pin Tool, you can find it in 3D window. And then in 2D or 3D just draw a box over the area, that need to be fixed. To delete it just right mouse click and choose remove selected pin or Ctrl+W to remove all pins. Pin Tool is very useful, it saves a lot, so I recommend checking on YT videos about this tool.
Reply 1: Thank you so much! I've been struggling with this for days, but now that I understand it, I'm so happy.❤️🙂😍😭👍🏻🙏🏻👏
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on how to add and use red fixing points in CLO 3D to suspend patterns in the air during simulation.

title: Crochet Effect in CLO 🧶
content:
Want to recreate this cozy crochet flower texture in CLO? Here's how I did it using the **Knitwear material settings**!  
👇 These are the parameters I used:

🧵 **Stitching** : Stockinette  
🧶 **Yarn Thickness** : 7.00  
📏 **Gauge** : 2.20  
📍 **Generate Seams** : ON  
🔁 **Length** : 100 mm  
🌙 **Curvature** : 0.5  
✨ **Reflection Roughness** : 50

I also played with **Yarn Variance** and a soft **melange effect** to give it depth and realism. Perfect for playful and soft designs like this floral dress! 

Let me know if you try it! 

![ea367a04031f4b91ba8ed9a431481490](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/ea367a04031f4b91ba8ed9a431481490Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113905.png)![8b3600c97db14bc9a4ab86604d7260ef](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/8b3600c97db14bc9a4ab86604d7260efCaptura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113945.png)![479d1dbe1da24cba91a9cfc373e5c329](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/479d1dbe1da24cba91a9cfc373e5c329Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20113958.png)![d339cdbe19074d82a5f4ff4c9790d222](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/ad24327810c546b48268ccae2c4a9f37/images/d339cdbe19074d82a5f4ff4c9790d222Captura%20de%20pantalla%202025-06-15%20114014.png)

title: Showing 2D Measurements on the Pattern and Modifying Them with Specific Values
content:
**Question 1)** I exported a pattern from Seamly2D in DXF format and imported it into CLO3D.

Is there a way to display the pattern measurements on the 2D window? Something like in AutoCAD?

For example, if the shoulder line is 13 cm, I want to see that measurement so I can decide to change it to 12 cm.

I want to work with exact values.

**Question 2)** After exporting the DXF from Seamly2D and importing it into CLO3D, I find the shoulder line a bit too long.

How can I reduce its length?

I want to enter an exact value, like 12 cm, instead of dragging it manually.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Answer to Question 1. In floating menu in 2D choose Line length or use Shift+Z shortcut.

Comment 2: Hi. Answer to Question 2. With edit pattern choose the shoulder line - right mouse click - Change length. There you tip the exact value you want, just check in which direction is pointing the arow, this indicates from where it will be shortened. You can adjust it with "Direction": start, end or both.
content_description: This page provides guidance on displaying precise pattern measurements and editing exact dimensions in CLO3D after importing DXF files from Seamly2D.

title: Assets saved in 2024 not being copied over to 2025
content:
If you have custom poses or fabrics/whatever you saved into the documents clo asset folder, for example I save poses in the avatar pose folder. You have to manually copy them back over to the new CLO Asset folder for 2025.

If you switch from the new library to the old one you have to manually add the folder back as well.
content_description: This page provides instructions for manually transferring and managing custom poses and assets when updating or switching between CLO asset libraries.

title: Measuring On Avatar With Feedback Line
content:
**Question 1:**

I want to take measurements on the avatar with the following options:

A) **Surface Distance:** Curved measurement that follows the contours of the body surface.

B) **Straight Line Distance:** Straight (air) measurement between two points.

**Question 2:**

While taking these measurements, I want a measurement line to appear.

Even better, I want this line to stay visible (a feedback line) so I can clearly see exactly where the measurement was taken.

**Question 3:**

If there is a measurement list, I want the measurements to be saved there.

**How can I do all this?**

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi! You can do this with the Avatar Tape Measure Tool.👉 For surface distance (curved):Go to Avatar > Measure > Add Tape Measure (On Avatar) and click two points on the body — it follows the surface.👉 For straight (air) distance:Same tool — just select two points, and it will draw a straight line between them.The line should stay visible until you manually hide or delete it. You can control its visibility under Avatar Display > Tape Measure.And yes — the measurements are saved automatically in the Avatar Tape Measure List (check the Object Browser > Avatar > Tape Measure). You can rename, hide, or export them if you need.Hope this helps! 😊
content_description: This web page provides guidance on implementing avatar measurement tools that include surface and straight-line distances, persistent measurement lines for visual feedback, and a saved measurement list.
